title: Structural sensing triggers (heartbeat + session-end)
summary: All three original reflections identified sensing gap. Six subsequent reflections (Feb 23-28) unanimously found the problem self-resolved without structural intervention. Real work generates natural sensing. Two minimal protocol additions emerged: (1) duplicate-prevention one-liner for AGENTS.md, (2) memory-file as idle-day proxy. Original structural trigger proposal is over-engineered. Dissolution recommended.
proposed_change: DISSOLVE candidate. Add two sentences to AGENTS.md: (1) before sensing, check last entry timestamp — if same session within 30 minutes, update rather than append; (2) to distinguish idle from sensing failure, check memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md existence — absence = genuine idle. No structural triggers needed.
dissolution_reason: Self-resolved without structural intervention. 6/6 reflections unanimous. Two one-liners added to AGENTS.md in lieu of structural triggers.

title: Gap between diagnosis/build and production deployment
summary: Recurring pattern: fixes diagnosed or code built but not deployed. 8+ instances across Feb 26 - Mar 14. CF Pages repos repeatedly built but not deployed. Pattern persists — Yu bottleneck for some deploys.
proposed_change: Add deployment checkpoint to AGENTS.md: [PP:DEPLOY] marker, [PP:COMPLETE] requires deployment confirmed or blockage documented.
last_evidence: 2026-03-11: CF Pages repos built but not deployed; pattern confirmed structural

title: Post-deploy health verification gap
summary: Systems deployed and appearing healthy but silently degrading. Cambridge TCG session token (6 weeks silent), exchange rate staleness (43 days), Forge IP shift, Sage/Ledger VPS silent 5+ days. Monitoring must be part of deploy, not separate.
proposed_change: Add [PP:HEALTH] marker to AGENTS.md: post-deploy, verify the critical path (endpoint responds, cron fires, data flows).
last_evidence: 2026-03-14: Sage/Ledger €7/mo running 5 days with zero heartbeats

title: Steady-state sensing deduplication for quiet days
summary: On quiet days, heartbeat cadence produces 11-14 near-identical sense entries. Third evolution of echo-chamber pattern (after meta-echo and session-duplicate). Trans-001 fix doesn't catch this because entries are >30min apart but informationally identical.
proposed_change: Add steady-state dedup rule to AGENTS.md: if previous sense reports no change AND no new interaction, skip sensing and HEARTBEAT_OK. Sense only on: new signal, new interaction, first/last of day, or >6h gap.
last_evidence: 2026-03-14: 14 entries / 3 effective (79% redundancy), second consecutive day

title: Live-API smoke test before SDK/docs publish
summary: SDK READMEs and docs written before API was finalized, causing 15 corrective SDK versions in one day. Pattern: docs from memory, not from live tests. A 30-second curl test before publishing would catch most mismatches.
proposed_change: Add rule: before any SDK or docs publish, run a live-API smoke test against the actual endpoint. Docs from live tests, not memory.
